SQL.SQL:
USE SGIF 
SELECT Ano, Codigo, Distrito, Concelho, Freguesia, [Local], INE as DTCCFR, 
  cast(DataAlerta as DATE) as DataAlerta, HoraAlerta, 
  cast(Data1Intervencao as DATE) as Data1Intervencao, Hora1Intervencao, 
  cast(DataExtincao as DATE) as DataExtincao, HoraExtincao, 
  round(cast(datediff(second, cast(DataAlerta  + HoraAlerta as datetime), cast(DataExtincao + HoraExtincao as datetime))/3600.0 as float),1) as DuracaoHoras,
  AreaPov, AreaMato, AreaAgric, AreaPov + AreaMato + AreaAgric as AreaTotal, APS, FonteAlerta, Causa, 
  x_3763 as X_ETRS89, y_3763 as Y_ETRS89, x as X_CoordMilitar, y as Y_CoordMilitar, 
  lat as Lat_GMS, case when left(lon,1)<>'-' then '-' + lon else lon end as Lon_GMS, dbo.fazdecimal(lat) as Lat_Decimal, -1*abs(dbo.fazdecimal(lon)) as Lon_Decimal,
  case when cast(datediff(second, cast(DataAlerta  + HoraAlerta as datetime), cast(DataExtincao + HoraExtincao as datetime))/3600.0 as float) > 24.0 then 1 else 0 end as In_cSup24h
FROM dbo.Stat_MasterT 
Where (fogacho=1 or incendio=1 or agricola=1 ) and  (Ano between 2001 and 2019)  -- and codigo in ('TM213444', 'TM213445')
Order by dataalerta

SQL.Unnamed: 3:
USE SGIF

SELECT
   Codigo as Codigo_SGIF, CodigoSado as Codigo_ANEPC
   ,Ano, Mes, Dia, Hora
   ,AreaPov, AreaMato, AreaAgric, AreaTotal
   ,case when AreaTotal <1 then ']0 a 1 ha[' 
      when AreaTotal <10 then '[1 a 10 ha]'
      when AreaTotal <20 then '[10 a 20 ha]'
   when AreaTotal <50 then '[20 a 50 ha]'
   when AreaTotal <100 then '[50 a 100 ha]'
   when AreaTotal <500 then '[100 a 500 ha]'
   when AreaTotal <1000 then '[500 a 1000 ha]'
   when AreaTotal >=1000 then '[superior a 1000 ha]' end as ClasseArea
   ,DHInicio as DataHoraAlerta, DH1Intervencao DataHora_PrimeiraIntervencao, DHFim as DataHora_Extincao, Duracao as Duracao_Horas, Case when duracao>= 24 then 1 else 0 end as IncSup24horas
   ,INE as DTCCFR, Distrito, Concelho, Freguesia, Local
   ,APS as RNAP,Perimetro as RNMPF
   ,x_20790 as X_Militar, y_20790 as Y_Militar, Lat_4326 as Latitude, Lon_4326 as Longitude, x_3763 as X_ETRS89, y_3763 as Y_ETRS89
   ,DSR, FWI, ISI, DC, DMC, FFMC, BUI
   ,Causa as CodCausa, TipoCausa, GrupoCausa, Descricao as DescricaoCausa 
   ,FonteAlerta      
FROM SGIF.dbo.Stat_MasterT_Export
WHERE ano between 2001 and 2010
ORDER BY dhinicio

SQL.SQL:
CONCELHOS

USE SGIF  Select  Ano, DTCC, Distrito, Concelho, NUTS3,
 SUM(NIncendios+NFogachos+NAgricola) as Num_IncendiosRurais,
 Case when ano>=2017 then Sum(AreaPov) end as AreaArdPov_NoConcelho,
 Case when ano>=2017 then Sum(AreaMato) end as AreaArdMato_NoConcelho,
 Case when ano>=2017 then Sum(AreaAgric) end as AreaArdAgric_NoConcelho,
 Case when ano>=2017 then Sum(AreaTotal) end as AreaArdTotal_NoConcelho,
 Case when ano<2017 then Sum(AreaPov) end as AreaArdPov_IncendioInicioConc,
 Case when ano<2017 then Sum(AreaMato) end as AreaArdMato_IncendioInicioConc,
 Case when ano<2017 then Sum(AreaAgric) end as AreaArdAgric_IncendioInicioConc,
 Case when ano<2017 then Sum(AreaTotal) end as AreaArdTotal_IncendioInicioConc,
 SUM(NIncRur_0_1ha) as NIncRur_0_1ha, 
 SUM(NIncRur_1_10ha) as NIncRur_1_10ha, 
 SUM(NIncRur_10_20ha) as NIncRur_10_20ha, 
 SUM(NIncRur_20_50ha) as NIncRur_20_50ha, 
 SUM(NIncRur_50_100ha) as NIncRur_50_100ha, 
 SUM(NIncRur_100_500ha) as NIncRur_100_500ha, 
 SUM(NIncRur_500_1000ha) as NIncRur_500_1000ha, 
 SUM(NIncRur_1000_n_ha) as NIncRur_1000_n_ha,
 SUM(NNatural) as NInc_Natural,
 SUM(NNegligente) as NInc_Negligente,
 SUM(NIntenconais) as NInc_Intencionais,
 SUM(NReacendimentos) as NInc_Reacendimentos,
 SUM(NDesconhecida) as NInc_Desconhecida,
 SUM(NIncendios+NFogachos+NAgricola-NNatural-NNegligente-NIntenconais-NReacendimentos-NDesconhecida) as NInc_NaoInvestigados,
  isnull(NumInc_Sup24h,0) as NumInc_Sup24h
From RELATORIO_Stat_Concelho_EntreDatasIII_2023  
LEFT JOIN (Select concelho as Concelho24h, ano as ano24h, count(*) as NumInc_Sup24h from Stat_MasterT_Export where DuracaoHoras>=24 group by concelho, ano) t24
  on ano = ano24h and concelho = concelho24h COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT

Where Ano between 2023 and 2023 -- and concelho = 'Vila de Rei'

Group by Ano, DTCC, Distrito, Concelho, Concelho24h, ano24h, NumInc_Sup24h, NUTS3
Order by Ano, DTCC

USE SGIF
Select Ano, Classif as Tipo_AP, Nome, COUNT(*) as Num_IncendiosRurais, 
SUM(Case when areatotal < 1 THEN  1 ELSE 0 END) AS NIncRurAPS_0_1ha,
SUM(Case when areatotal >=1 and areatotal <  5 THEN  1 ELSE 0 END) AS NIncRurAPS_1_5ha,
SUM(Case when areatotal >=5 and areatotal < 20 THEN  1 ELSE 0 END) AS NIncRurAPS_5_20ha,
SUM(Case when areatotal >=20 and areatotal<100 THEN  1 ELSE 0 END) AS NIncRurAPS_20_100ha,
SUM(Case when areatotal >=100 THEN  1 ELSE 0 END) AS NIncRurAPS_100_n_ha
From Stat_MasterT left join afn_geografia.dbo.AP2013 ap on aps=ap.nome COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS 
Where (Incendio=1 or Fogacho=1 or Agricola=1) and APS is not null -- and Ano = 2016
Group by Ano, Nome, Classif
Order by Ano, Classif
